rationale: The focused protected-cargo panel is a plausible, mechanistically testable, and MISEV-consistent exploratory approach and should proceed to the proposed orthogonal fraction-level experiments. Critical validation requirements must be satisfied during testing (analytical sensitivity in low-biomass capture fractions, validated capture-reagent compatibility, exogenous intact-EV spike-in controls, ≥3 independent/including scaled lots, stability/timepoint sampling, and orthogonal assays to exclude tightly bound soluble co‑isolates); until those are met it must not be used as an operational lot gate or potency surrogate.
